question: In 1867, Keshab Chunder Sen helped found the Prarthana Samaj in __________ .
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bombay**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Keshab Chunder Sen:-**

 
 
• He was a prominent Indian social reformer and religious leader who played a significant role in the Indian Renaissance movement of the 19th century.
 
 
 
• **Prarthana Samaj:-**
 
 
• It was a Hindu reform movement founded by Atmaram Pandurang in Bombay in 1867.
 
• Keshab Chunder Sen was one of the key members of the organization.
 
• The main objective of Prarthana Samaj was to promote monotheism, social equality, and rational thinking among Hindus.
 
• It also aimed to eradicate social evils like caste system, child marriage, and widow remarriage. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pune:-**

 
 
• Prarthana Mandir founded in Pune in 1850 by Mahadev Govind Ranade.
